title: Final Answer
description: Essential Criteria: The correct threshold energy for the gamma ray must be provided.

title: Conservation of Energy
description: Important Criteria: The student should demonstrate understanding of energy conservation in the context of the reaction.

title: Invariant Mass Calculation
description: Important Criteria: The calculation of invariant mass and its relation to the threshold condition must be shown.

title: Correct Mass Values
description: Important Criteria: The student must use the correct mass of the electron in calculations.

title: Unit Consistency
description: Optional Criteria: The response should maintain consistent units throughout the calculations.

title: Sign Errors
description: Pitfall Criteria: Watch for common sign mistakes in energy or momentum calculations.

title: Missing Factors
description: Pitfall Criteria: Ensure that all necessary factors, such as the number of particles created, are included.
